name: reboot-residue R-002 live: Ornith cold start through the gateway leaves the embed sidecar and kokoro running (after the EI-25222670171204378 watchdog fix)
summary: llama-ornith.service was stopped (the clause's cold precondition), then a POST to the gateway :8788/v1/chat/completions for maxwell1500/ornith-35b:IQ3_M started it on demand and answered HTTP 200 after 305s with that model. A sampler sent a cache-bypassing /embed request every 2s throughout and for 240s after the answer. papercup-embed-sidecar.service kept MainPID 2121735, NRestarts 1 and ExecMainStartTimestamp 05:47:41 EDT from before the stop to after the tail; voicemode-kokoro.service kept ExecMainStartTimestamp 00:30:47 EDT. The watchdog's only failed probe (10:05:15Z, a 15s timeout) was logged as 1/2 consecutive and did not restart the sidecar.
scope: Live host plane. The probe stops llama-ornith.service once (precondition) and issues one completion; it does not restart any other unit. The first grading run (EI-25223052791034587) saw the old watchdog restart the sidecar at this point and loop it down for 11+ minutes; the watchdog now has a 180s startup grace, a non-blocking restart and a 2-consecutive-failure threshold (apps/operator/scripts/systemd/papercup-embed-sidecar-watchdog.sh). Latency disclosure: of 193 /embed samples the median was 0.053s, 3 exceeded 15s (30.0s client timeout at 10:04:56Z during the load, then 22.0s at 10:07:08Z and 21.8s at 10:08:26Z after ornith had answered), so the stalls are not confined to the load window and are not attributed to ornith here.
oracle: Independent of the fix under test: systemd unit properties read before and after, the gateway's HTTP answer and journal, nvidia-smi, and an external /embed sampler.
redaction: In the retained log the operator's home directory is rendered as ~ and the box hostname as <host> (redacted by hand at 10:31Z after git-sync quarantined the raw capture for an identity leak); no other byte changed.

assertions.evidence: llama-ornith.service is-active = inactive after the stop, before the request.

COMPLETION_HTTP=200 after 305s; response model maxwell1500/ornith-35b:IQ3_M; gateway journal: unit audit clean for 'ornith-llamaserver' (10:01:36Z) and 'started on demand and is answering' (10:06:31Z).
PRE and POST papercup-embed-sidecar.service = MainPID 2121735, NRestarts 1, ExecMainStartTimestamp Tue 2026-10-06 05:47:41 EDT, active/running.
PRE and POST voicemode-kokoro.service ExecMainStartTimestamp Tue 2026-10-06 00:30:47 EDT.
Watchdog journal since START: one line 'embed worker probe failed (1/2 consecutive) — not restarting yet' at 10:05:15Z; no restart line.
Disclosure, not a pass condition: 193 samples, 1 non-200 (client 30s timeout), 0 bad accounting, 3 over 15s, max 30.0s, median 0.053s.
